title: 第29章 你是不是有什么受虐倾向？
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: 班长坐在靠前位置，并未察觉到孔垄的异常。但台上的指导员却已经注意到这边，并皱起眉头。陆阳用笔戳了一下丁腾飞，让他赶紧提醒前面的孔垄。丁腾飞原本其实是有点儿想看他出糗挨骂的，毕竟这家伙一直跟自已不对付。但犹豫再三，他最终还是选择用笔戳了一下孔垄的后背，作为提醒。却没想到这家伙不知道受了什么刺激，忽然一个猛子起身。脑袋咣当一下撞在了桌子底下，差点没把桌子都给顶翻了。巨大的动静让其他开小差，打瞌睡的新兵瞬间惊醒，纷纷故作疑惑的扭头看向这边。“怎么回事？”孔垄赶紧装模作样的拿起那支中性笔，心虚的解释：“报告，我，我捡个笔。”何镇涛双手环抱胸前，调侃道：“去梦里去捡的？”“......”“困的，没精神的，打瞌睡的，都给我站起来听！”哗啦啦，凳子被推动的声音响起。整个阅览室里几乎一半以上新兵都站了起来，这可给何镇涛气得不轻。他走下讲台，去一个个检查新兵们的笔记，本子上全都跟苍蝇绕似的，不知道在鬼画符些什么。还是看到陆阳本子上工整的字迹，密集的知识点后，心情这才稍稍好一些。起码，还是有一个人在认真听课的，认真做笔记的！何镇涛拿起陆阳的笔记本，冲着所有人举起。“看看人家的笔记，字迹工整条理有序，重点全都记下了；再看看你们的笔记，你们好意思吗？”“我刚刚讲的这些，全部都是重点，下连时候要考的！”“上届没考，这一届肯定考！”陆阳莫名觉得，这番话似乎有些熟悉，好像在哪儿听过？何镇涛冷哼一声：“我知道，很多人都是因为不想学习，怕念书才来当得兵。但我要告诉你们的是，部队对于文化的看重，不比大学校园差！”“当兵，拼到最后，拼的是什么，你告诉我？”“体力？”被点名的兵自信满满的刚回答，就被指导员否定了。“错，是脑子！”“打仗是一门很深奥的学问，不是像小混混那样，拉开阵仗相互火拼，那能有什么技术含量？”丁腾飞脸上火辣辣的，像是忽然被抽了几个大巴掌。“更不是，把块头练得跟健美先生一样，那有什么用，上了战场就是活靶子。”“块头越大，战场上中枪几率越高；受了伤还会成为队伍的累赘，扛不动也拽不走。”孔垄也像是突然被人指着鼻子骂了一顿，弄得他想再度钻到桌子底下去。“指挥战斗，需要大量的军事理论，心理学，兵法作为基础，然后再加上实践。”“即便你们中绝大多数人无法成为指挥员，但作为一名战士，枪械保养理论基础，地形地貌测绘知识，战车和汽车简易维修，包括如何埋伏，如何隐藏，这些都是要去认真学习的！”“当兵要学的东西不比上大学少，如果想在部队里好好干，就给我从现在起养成认真学习的习惯，去好好做笔记！”“尤其是那些想要留队，下连以后想去教导队培训当班长的，更是得在这方面下功夫！”“部队是看重体能，但对于知识的学习和探索，也从未停下过脚步！”“只有掌握旁人不会的知识和技能，才能在部队里走得更远，走的更广！”何镇涛说的很直白，部队不光拼体能，同样拼文化拼知识。03年大裁军，首先裁撤掉的一大批，就是文化学历不过关的。时代在发展，部队里的武器装备也在更新迭代，而如何正确使用这些武器，需要夯实的理论基础作为支持。比如：敌方坦克以每小时六十千米速度逃窜，敌我相距一千五百米，我方坦克以时速七十千米每小时追击，问多久才能追上敌人？再比如，朝着移动中朝目标开火还需要测算车速，和炮弹飞行时间。就连迫击炮打击目标都需要计算诸元，也就是所谓的方位角、高低角，以及抛物线距离。而这些，都需要用到数学公式去计算，甚至在特定环境下找只能心算。所以当兵不仅得拼体力，还得拼文化，拼知识储备，拼各类专业技能。好在有系统加持，专注力提升后的陆阳觉得学起东西来，好像都比以往轻松了许多何镇涛重新返回前头讲课，孔垄则悄悄扭过头，小声询问周凯东。“班长，我没驾照，下连也能有机会开上坦克吗？”“旁人可以，你大概率没机会。”“为啥？”“你塞不进去，口太小。”孔垄满脸尴尬，其余人则全都在憋笑。但丁腾飞却露出一副心驰神往的表情，仿佛已经坐在驾驶舱里。装甲，战车，炮火，引擎轰鸣，试问哪个热血男儿能够抵挡钢铁洪流的诱惑？......课上完，三班新兵直接被周凯东带去了器械训练场。所谓器械训练，其实就是单杠，双杠一类的练习。引体向上，双杠臂屈伸，也是所有人必须掌握的。新训期间引体向上六个算及格，九个良好，十二个优秀。目前，陆阳引体向上只能做五个，第六个死活上不去。而三班除了孔垄能拉十个，其余人水平和陆阳差不太多，甚至还有不如他的。毕竟，入伍还不到一个月，体能想要这么快提升上来根本就不现实。周凯东背着手：“鉴于，入伍这么多天了，你们引体向上死活拉不上去，我准备采取一些必要措施来帮帮你们。”说罢，他就从背后拿出一捆大号胶带纸，笑眯眯的说：“待会，我就用这玩意儿，把你吊在上头，吊它个半小时，我看谁还拉不上去。”此话一出，新兵们顿时菊花已经，虎躯一震。这特么是人想出来的点子吗，你当时晒腊肉呢？【检测到新知识点：吊杠（进阶版）！】【知识点分析：利用工具，物理性的将双手捆绑在单杠上，训练过程中可对臂力，抓握力，耐力提供x3倍速提升！】陆阳眼睛一亮，上道具效果居然比单纯吊杆还要好？这让他迫不及待的想要去尝试一下，吊杠进阶版到底有多酸爽！周凯东一个一个，像是晒腊肉那样，将新兵们的双手用胶带纸捆在单杠上。随之而来的便是一阵阵的痛苦和哀嚎，尤其是孔垄手上汗毛多，周凯东先前不知道是有意无意的，还帮他来了把局部脱毛，疼的他眼泪都下来了。“上去吧！”“是！”陆阳远比其他人要主动的多，自觉性也非常高。甚至于，刚入伍才几天的时候，他就已经有兵的样子了。但，看着陆阳满眼期待的眼神，周凯东还是忍不住打了个寒颤。他严重怀疑，陆阳是不是有什么受虐倾向？其他人都是一副要死要活的模样，就他是迫不及待！“班长，快绑我，快把我绑起来啊！”“来啊，绑紧一点，牢一点，最好多缠几圈！”“陆阳，你冷静点，班长有点儿慌.....”
content_en: The monitor sat near the front and did not notice anything unusual about Kong Long.But the instructor on the stage had already noticed this and frowned.Lu Yang poked Ding Tengfei with his pen and asked him to quickly remind Kong Rong in front of him.Ding Tengfei actually wanted to see him embarrassed and scolded, after all, this guy had always been at odds with him.But after much hesitation, he finally chose to poke Kong Long's back with a pen as a reminder.Unexpectedly, this guy suddenly stood up suddenly due to some stimulation.My head hit the bottom of the table with such a bang that it almost overturned the table.The huge movement caused other recruits who had deserted and dozed off to wake up instantly, and they all turned their heads to look this way in pretense of confusion."What's going on?" Kong Long quickly picked up the gel pen in a pretentious manner and explained guiltily: "Report, I, I will pick up a pen." He Zhentao crossed his arms over his chest and joked: "Go and pick it up in your dream?"Almost half of the recruits in the entire reading room stood up, which made He Zhentao very angry.He walked down from the podium and went to check the recruits' notes one by one. The notebooks were all like flies, and he didn't know what they were writing.After seeing the neat handwriting and dense knowledge points in Lu Yang's notebook, I felt a little better.At least, there is still someone who is listening to the class and taking notes seriously!He Zhentao picked up Lu Yang's notebook and raised it towards everyone."Look at their notes, the handwriting is neat and orderly, and all the key points have been written down; look at your notes, are you sorry?" "What I just said are all key points, and I will take the test in the next semester!" "I didn't take the test last time, but I will definitely take the test this time!" Lu Yang felt inexplicably that these words seemed familiar, as if he had heard them somewhere?He Zhentao snorted coldly: "I know that many people come to be soldiers because they don't want to study and are afraid of studying. But what I want to tell you is that the military values ​​culture as much as college campuses!" "Being a soldier means fighting to the end. What do you fight for? Tell me?" "Physical strength?" The soldier who was named answered confidently, but was denied by the instructor."Wrong, it's the brain!" "Warfare is a very profound knowledge. It's not like a gang of gangsters fighting each other. What kind of technical content can it have?" Ding Tengfei's face was burning, as if he had been slapped suddenly."Not to mention, what's the use of training to be as big as a bodybuilder? You'll be a living target on the battlefield." "The bigger you are, the higher the chance of getting shot on the battlefield; if you get injured, you will become a burden to the team. You can't carry it or drag it away." Kong Long also seemed to be pointed at his nose and scolded suddenly, making him want to crawl under the table again."Commanding a battle requires a lot of military theory, psychology, and art of war as the basis, and then coupled with practice." "Even if most of you cannot become commanders, as a soldier, you must study the theoretical basis of firearm maintenance, knowledge of terrain surveying, and simple maintenance of tanks and automobiles, including how to ambush and hide. These are all things you need to learn seriously!" "Being a soldier requires no less learning than going to college. If you want to do a good job in the army, just start from now.Develop the habit of serious study and take notes!""Especially those who want to stay in the team and train as squad leaders in the future must work hard in this area!" "The army values physical fitness, but it has never stopped learning and exploring knowledge!" "Only by mastering knowledge and skills that others do not know can you go further and further in the army!" He Zhentao said very straightforwardly. The army not only strives for physical fitness, but also for culture and knowledge.In the major disarmament in 2003, a large number of people who were first laid off were those whose education and education were not up to standard.As the times evolve, the weapons and equipment in the army are also updated and iterated, and how to use these weapons correctly requires a solid theoretical foundation as support.For example: an enemy tank is fleeing at a speed of 60 kilometers per hour. The enemy and we are 1,500 meters apart. Our tanks are chasing at a speed of 70 kilometers per hour. How long will it take to catch up with the enemy?For another example, firing at a moving target also requires measuring the speed of the vehicle and the flight time of the projectile.Even mortar attack targets need to calculate various elements, which are the so-called azimuth angle, elevation angle, and parabolic distance.All of these require the use of mathematical formulas to calculate, or even mental arithmetic under certain circumstances.Therefore, being a soldier not only requires physical strength, but also culture, knowledge reserves, and various professional skills.Fortunately, with the blessing of the system, Lu Yang felt that learning things seemed much easier than before after his concentration improved. He Zhentao returned to the front to give lectures, while Kong Long quietly turned his head and asked Zhou Kaidong in a low voice."Squad leader, I don't have a driver's license, can my subordinate company still have a chance to drive a tank?" "Others can, but you most likely have no chance." "Why?" "You can't fit it in, the mouth is too small." Kong Rong looked embarrassed, and the others were all suppressing laughter.Ding Tengfei showed a fascinated expression, as if he was already sitting in the cockpit.Armor, tanks, artillery fire, roaring engines, which passionate man can resist the temptation of the torrent of steel?...After the class, the recruits from Class Three were taken directly to the equipment training ground by Zhou Kaidong.The so-called equipment training is actually exercises such as horizontal bars and parallel bars.Pull-ups and parallel bar dips and extensions are also something everyone must master.During the new training period, six pull-ups are considered a pass, nine are good, and 12 are excellent.Currently, Lu Yang can only do five pull-ups, and cannot do the sixth one.Except for Kong Long, who can pull ten, the level of the rest of the third class is about the same as Lu Yang, and some are even worse than him.After all, it has been less than a month since he joined the army, and it is simply unrealistic to improve his physical fitness so quickly.Zhou Kaidong clasped his hands behind his back and said: "Since you have been in the army for so many days and you are still unable to pull up, I am going to take some necessary measures to help you." After that, he took out a bundle of large tape papers from behind and said with a smile: "I will use this thing to hang you on top for half an hour. I will see who can't pull it up." As soon as these words came out, the recruits suddenly had their chrysanthemums turned and their bodies shook.Is this an idea that people came up with? Where were you drying bacon?[New knowledge point detected: hanging bar (advanced version)!】【Knowledge point analysis: Use tools to physically tie your hands to the horizontal bar. During the training process, arm strength, grip strength, and endurance can be improved x3 times!】Lu Yang's eyes lit up. The effect of using props is actually better than that of a simple boom?This made him eager to try it out, just how refreshing the advanced version of the hanging bar was!One by one, Zhou Kaidong tied the hands of the recruits to the horizontal bar with tape, like drying bacon.What followed was bursts of pain and wailing, especially because Kong Long had so much hair on his hands. Zhou Kaidong didn't know whether it was intentional or not, but he even helped him with partial hair removal. The pain made him shed tears."Go up!" "Yes!" Lu Yang was far more proactive than others and was very self-conscious.Even just a few days after joining the army, he already looked like a soldier.However, seeing Lu Yang's expectant eyes, Zhou Kaidong couldn't help but shudder.He seriously doubted whether Lu Yang had any masochistic tendencies?Everyone else looked like they were dying, but he couldn't wait any longer!"Squad leader, tie me up quickly, tie me up quickly!" "Come on, tie me tighter, stronger, it's best to wrap it around a few more times!" "Lu Yang, calm down, the monitor is a little panicked..."
